I have planned the rollout for the fee rounding change, updated `RELEASE.md` with the decision, and added input validation and automated tests.

### Changes Made
- **[RELEASE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-gNb1sc/workspace/RELEASE.md)**: Documented the release decision (`flagged: yes`), rollout strategy using feature flag / shadow release, observability and nightly reconciliation audit plan, and flag removal condition while retaining the existing `kubectl` rollback command.
- **[src/pricing.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-gNb1sc/workspace/src/pricing.js)**: Preserved the new invoice total fee calculation (`Math.round((total * rateBasisPoints) / 10_000)`) while adding trust-boundary type validation for arguments.
- **[test/pricing.test.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-gNb1sc/workspace/test/pricing.test.js)**: Added unit test suite covering invoice total fee calculation, empty line items array, and input validation boundaries.
- **[package.json](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-gNb1sc/workspace/package.json)**: Updated the test runner script command to `node --test`.

### What Was Verified
- Executed `npm test` via Node.js native test runner and confirmed all 4 test cases (`createApp builds a router`, `feeMinor calculates fee on total invoice amount`, `feeMinor handles empty line items array`, and `feeMinor validates input arguments at trust boundaries`) passed cleanly with exit code 0.
